# 360 Rentals

360 Rentals is a 360 photo booth rental company serving Salt Lake City and the Salt Lake Valley in Utah.

## Website

- Home: https://www.360rentalsusa.com/
- Bookings: https://www.360rentalsusa.com/#book

## Core Offerings

- Self-Serve 360: $80/hr
- Share-Ready 360: $115/hr
- White-Glove 360: $135/hr

## Service Area

- Salt Lake City
- Sandy
- Draper
- Murray
- South Jordan
- West Jordan
- Herriman
- Riverton
- Midvale
- Taylorsville

## Business Context

- Preferred vendor partnerships
- Venue add-on options
- Wedding, party, corporate, and quinceanera events
